verdict.rationale: Logseq documents an official `logseq://x-callback-url/quickCapture` protocol that can be saved as a browser bookmark (bookmarklet-style) to send short text and links into the graph, with configurable quick-capture templates that include {url} and {text}. It is explicitly scoped to "short text and links" rather than full-page or article clipping. missing for 10: dedicated official browser clipper extension, full web page/article content capture, persistent web highlight capture, hands-on or independent corroboration of the capture flow.
